story: Research question -> shared RAG flow -> exact source and canonical answer -> downloaded evidence/claim/tag file bytes -> answer-linked QA feedback -> monitoring and persisted page reload. Native JSONL rehearsal is separate from required PostgreSQL/Compose rehearsal.
models: No overlapping LLM calls during the timed experiment; preview first. Any later diagnostic LLM request is counted separately and is not a selected-release proof.
seed: Copies the current verified new-repository ingestion JSONL/report into an isolated QA runtime; no private predecessor data dependency.
